hook: Your friend may see a different move.
text: Your friend may see a different move. ♟️ Use your personal invite link in Profile to bring a chess friend into Web3Chess. Ask them to try free AI practice. Give each other one focus: watch the back rank, spot hanging pieces, or check every recapture. After a game, compare which habit helped most. A good invite gives someone a reason to play. Open the app, copy your link from Profile, and choose one friend.

creative.headline:
TWO FRIENDS.
*BETTER IDEAS.*
creative.footer: Share your personal link. Compare your practice.
